title: Docs: Revalidation behavior is instance-local by default, not clearly highlighted for multi-instance/serverless environments
author: Akash504-ai
body_preview: ### What is the documentation issue? author: Apsysikal
body_preview: In version `5.0.0` LazyFile stopped extending `File` and `Blob`. The reasons, although not applicable to me, seem like a great thing.
